verdict.rationale: Skyvern is driven programmatically without a UI. It offers a REST API with an OpenAPI spec, Python and TypeScript SDKs, and API-key authentication. Runs execute in cloud browsers, or self-hosted via pip, Docker Compose or Kubernetes, and send a completion webhook. Cached, deterministic Playwright replays and end-to-end browser testing are documented use cases, which fits unattended automation pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI integration docs (e.g., GitHub Actions or CLI exit-code behavior), a documented headless-mode setting, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
